children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Change the API store without breaking SQLite-first installs, optional PostgreSQL builds, startup ordering, or rollback safety.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Released migration files are immutable; every schema change gets the next ordered transactional file.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Platform identity and settings live in the database while desired infrastructure remains in CRDs.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: SQLite is default and single-connection; PostgreSQL uses a build tag.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Users, sessions, roles, config, and audit data live here.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Shared SQL in migrations/common/ runs in filename order after the per-driver sets.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Add one portable, immutable, zero-padded SQL file and use a transaction that records success only at completion.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Never rewrite an already released migration.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Keep SQL portable across SQLite and PostgreSQL.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Use SQLite-safe rebuilds where constraints cannot be altered.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Test fresh schema, prior-version upgrade, reopen, transaction rollback, and both database build modes.
